work.name: MiniMax
work.summary: Contributed throughout the M3.1 Flash iteration.
highlights: Built an RSI-oriented post-training loop (task synthesis → verifier → SFT/RL) to train RL experts for optimization tasks, improving performance on GSO and FrontierEng benchmarks.
Performance optimization: verifiable task synthesis from GitHub PRs, hack-resistant speedup reward design, and SFT/RL training for codebase performance optimization.
Engineering optimization: cross-disciplinary optimization task synthesis and simulator-based verifiers for SFT/RL training on simulation/design and AI4Science tasks.
